app_review_notes:
Home Movie is a local iPhone video recorder and editor. No login or subscription is required.

Tap + to create a movie and open the camera. Allow Camera and Microphone permissions to record a scene. Tap the red button to start/stop. Open the scene thumbnail to review/edit; Watch Movie plays the assembled project. Export saves a finished movie via Photos, Files, or the system share sheet. Photos permission is add-only and requested when saving.

Recording defaults (Standard/Apple Log and Cinema look) are in Settings. Apple Log, simultaneous front/rear PiP, zoom ranges and lens options depend on hardware support; test them on a supported physical iPhone. Dolly opens Start/End controls: select a point, choose a lens, and press Go. End edits do not move the camera until Go; countdown delays Dolly motion only, not recording.

Settings > Privacy includes the privacy policy. Projects and diagnostics stay local unless the user saves/shares them. Recently Deleted supports restore or permanent deletion; external Photos/Files copies remain separate.
